answer: An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the trellis index resolves every citation against the pigment checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the meadow audit keeps the resolved set. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 7 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
